audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers handed Volibear five straight rows (Levels 2 through first item) while whys[1] calls Level 2 your burst window, whys[2] calls Level 3 even, and whys[5] and whys[6] both say the matchup tips back to you.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill / Wukong / Skill / Volibear / Volibear / Wukong / Wukong and matches the prose. The mirror audit (volibear__wukong) applied exactly rows 1, 2, 5 and 6 as one atomic group.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 5 set to Wukong, row 2 to Skill, row 6 to Wukong as matched phases[N].side + win[N] pairs, ratings moved with them, and the stage explanations rewritten so none of them claims the wrong owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was the generic 'Cyclone's double knockup wins every committed brawl' line on Volibear's strongest row, and phases[6].why quoted a carry-threat number instead of naming what two items change.
audit.why: Stormbringer is a 550-range leap on 160/135/110s that grants bonus health and temporarily disables nearby enemy towers — that is his Level 6 spike and the reason the dive works. At two items the knock-up answering that leap is what returns the phase to Wukong.
audit.corrected: Level 6 stage now names the bonus health, the tower disable and the 160s rank-1 cooldown; the 2+ item stage names Cyclone answering the 550-range leap.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] 'Anti-heal his W heal', dontsFull[1] 'Extend into his W heal' and dontsFull[2] 'Fight his R tower-dive low' all carried bodies copied from other rows. Frenzied Maul's second-cast rule, Sky Splitter's conditional shield and the Stormbringer tower disable were never stated, and no cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's text: Frenzied Maul marks a target and only the repeat cast on that same target deals bonus damage and heals him, on a flat 5s. Sky Splitter shields him only if he is inside the blast radius, so it is his choice to stand in it. Stormbringer disables towers near his landing point, which is why sitting under turret low is not safe.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d states the second-cast rule; dontsFull[1].d states the 5s repeat heal; dontsFull[2].d states the tower disable and the 550 range; breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d carry Thundering Smash's 12s and auto reset, Maul's 5s, and Stormbringer's 160s.

edits.before: W clone bails out any misstep and baits his answer. Only take the trade when Volibear's Thundering Smash is down.
edits.after: Your window: Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1, so the moment it whiffs, Crushing Blow and Nimbus Strike land for free.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Volibear must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: It evens out as Frenzied Maul comes online — 5s cooldown, healing on the second cast, so short trades stop punishing him.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Thundering Smash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His stretch: Frenzied Maul heals every 5s and Sky Splitter shields him whenever he stands in it, so refuse the extended trade and farm.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Volibear's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stormbringer gives bonus health and disables your tower, on 160s at rank 1, so his dive out-stats anything you can hold.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Thundering Smash's cooldown.
edits.after: Black Cleaver plus Cyclone flips it back to you — force the fight on Thundering Smash's 12s.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Volibear carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Cyclone's knock-up answers a 550-range Stormbringer leap, so you peel his dives instead of absorbing them.

edits.before: - Volibear Thundering Smash: matchup-defining — His engage. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Thundering Smash: 12s at rank 1, his engage and an auto reset — decoy it. - Frenzied Maul: 5s, and it only heals on the second cast into the same target. - Stormbringer: 160s at rank 1 and it disables your tower.

edits.before: His engage. Decoy it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 12s at rank 1, and it resets his auto — bait it, then commit.

edits.before: Volibear wastes Thundering Smash (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Frenzied Maul only heals on the second cast into the same target — cut it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Maul is 5s — the longer you stand there the more he heals back.

edits.before: Burning W before the trade starts — the clone IS your defense, and committing without it means eating his full combo.
edits.after: Stormbringer disables your turret as it lands, so the tower will not save you — leave before he is in 550 range of it.
